title: Talking about a hobby and inviting a beginner
objectives: Name your hobby and explain it briefly
Describe what you enjoy about it
Invite the other person to a beginner session

courseTemplate.setting: Bouldering uses low climbing walls without ropes. The learner's gym offers a free beginner session.

roles.partner: A curious member of a hobby group

courseTemplate.openingLine: What do you like doing outside work?

targetPatterns.pattern: I go bouldering. It's climbing on low walls without ropes.

targetPatterns.pattern: At first, yes. Now I enjoy figuring out how to get to the top.

targetPatterns.pattern: What do you do for fun?

targetPatterns.pattern: How long have you been doing that?

stages.title: Name your hobby and explain it briefly
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “What do you like doing outside work?”
successCriteria: The learner can name your hobby and explain it briefly in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I go bouldering. It's …”

stages.title: Describe what you enjoy about it
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Isn't that a bit scary?”
successCriteria: The learner can describe what you enjoy about it in their own words.
hints: You can start with “At first, yes. Now …”

stages.title: Invite the other person to a beginner session
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “That sounds fun. Is it good for beginners?”
successCriteria: The learner can invite the other person to a beginner session in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Definitely. The first session …”
